title: Embedded Model Context Protocol (MCP) Vibecoding Engine
description: Implements an embedded Go JSON-RPC 2.0 Model Context Protocol server inside the Taawun control plane binary to expose tools for prompt auditing, container deployment, and P2P relay setup.
keyDecisions: DIRECT EMBEDDED GO MCP SERVER. Embedding JSON-RPC 2.0 directly inside the Go control plane binary eliminates the complexity of running a separate Rust or Python microservice.
